title: i18n(plugin-sharing): ship the sharing and queue objects in all eleven platform languages
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D7v5H7BaFmL7sUCoN7tSxhm)_

domain:server#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cya5ej5GQV86RPbRPK

Part of #30512 — package 8 of 11 (`@objectstack/plugin-sharing`). The card stays open: approvals, settings and platform-objects follow, and the last PR of the series makes the bundle check read the platform locale table.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 共享插件的 5 个对象（记录共享、共享规则、共享链接、队列、队列成员）的名称、字段、选项、帮助和视图名，补上繁中、阿语、法语、巴葡、俄语、德语、韩语 7 种，与平台语言表的 11 种一致。队列和队列成员也在内；队列记录页的标题也补了这 7 种（与各语言队列对象名同词）。
- **为什么改：** 平台语言表要求每个界面带齐 11 种语言；这是第 3 期按包补齐的第 8 个包（每种语言 151 条）。用这 7 种语言的管理员打开「设置 → 共享规则 / 队列」不再看到英文。
- **风险与回滚：** 只加翻译数据和注册行，不动逻辑、schema、接口；原有 4 种语言一字未改。唯一的测试改动是「收件人类型在各对象上叫法一致」的测试多扫 7 种语言（覆盖变宽，没有放宽任何断言）。回滚即撤 PR。
- **先看：** `src/translations/index.ts`（按表标签注册，zh-CN 在 zh-Hant 前，每种语言带上页面标题）、`src/translations/pages.ts`（手写的队列页标题表），再看 `recipient-vocabulary-consistency.test.ts`，最后抽看任一语言的 `sys_queue` 段。
- **两分钟验证：** `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --filter=sharing` 输出 `plugins/plugin-sharing in sync`；`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing test` 全绿。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- Seven new locales for the sharing package under the platform locale table's tags (`zh-Hant`, `ar`, `fr`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `de`, `ko`): each a `TAG.objects.generated.ts` with all 151 object leaves of `sys_record_share`, `sys_sharing_rule`, `sys_share_link`, `sys_queue` and `sys_queue_member`, plus its `TAG.source-hashes.generated.ts`, written by the repo's own `os i18n extract --fill=default --source-hashes` and served through `withSourceFallback` like the existing three. `zh-CN` stays ahead of `zh-Hant` in `index.ts`.
- The hand-written page table `src/translations/pages.ts` (the queue record page `sys_queue_detail`, from #30728) gains an entry per new locale. Each value is the locale's own `sys_queue` object label, so the page title and the object read the same word, and each records the same `en` digest the existing three carry. `index.ts` passes each new locale's `pages` entry and its recorded digest to `withSourceFallback`, like the existing three.
- The extract command in `scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts` lists the seven tags and its merge baseline imports the seven bundles with their page entries, so `check:i18n` covers them from this PR on.

## Tests

- `recipient-vocabulary-consistency.test.ts` (each recipient option reads the same on every object that offers it, within a locale) adds the seven new bundles to its list. Coverage widens; no assertion changed.
- `sys-queue-page.test.ts` already iterates every locale of `SharingTranslations` and checks the served page label equals the table's, so the seven new page labels are held to it with no test edit.

## Acceptance notes

- **Quality bar (#17508 / PR #19345):** every leaf written for the reader; placeholders, code spans and identifiers byte-identical, checked mechanically per leaf against `en` (key set, `{{holes}}`, `{holes}`, backtick spans, angle tokens: all seven locales OK, zero diffs). Arabic is RTL prose with identifiers left in Latin script. `zh-Hant` was checked character by character against OpenCC's Traditional (Taiwan) conversion: no Simplified-only character remains.
- **Leaves equal to English, on purpose, each recorded by the extractor as a source copy:** `fr` `Source`, `Description` (x2), `Audience`, `Public (indexable)`; `pt-BR` `Token`; `de` `Name` (x2), `Team` (x2), `Position` (x3), `Token`. All are the native words.
- No cross-locale coincidence: `check:i18n-stale-fill` passes with the baseline untouched.
- **Observation, not changed here:** the queue page's members list title in `src/sys-queue.page.ts` is an inline locale map with four entries (`en`, `zh-CN`, `ja-JP`, `es-ES`), none for the seven new locales. It is page prose outside this PR's surface.
- **Deviation from the handover commit:** carried from the released handover commit `ec0e96dc` (session `session_01Utp6Cai5CRdAs4u9gTipWU`), with one addition: main gained the queue record page and its hand-written four-locale `pages` section (#30728) after that commit was written, so the commit's `index.ts` and extract-config hunks conflicted. The resolution keeps #30728's wiring and adds the seven locales through it, which needed the seven page labels in `pages.ts`. The 14 generated bundle and source-hash files and the test change are byte-identical to the handover commit (blob ids compared); the changeset gains one sentence for the page title. The serial row "after #30208 lands" was cleared by the seat (6672288503): #30208 row 7, which first put `sys_queue` / `sys_queue_member` into this package's extract, landed in PR #30551.
